answer: In an autonomous AI economy, a cryptographic proof-of-stake mechanism augmented by zero-knowledge proofs can defeat Sybil swarms. By requiring agents to lock collateral behind a unique verifiable cipher linked to hardware execution units, the network forces adversaries to acquire scarce physical infrastructure. Each legitimate node must mirror its state transitions on a decentralized ledger, rendering the deployment of fake identities economically unviable since an attacker must pay the exponential sable cost of provisioning real computational chips for every single fabricated persona.
